run_metadata.coverage_summary: Discovery was performed via WebSearch (extended mode) only. This cloud session's network policy blocks direct page fetches: WebFetch returns getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for every non-allowlisted host (re-confirmed this run against https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm), and the egress proxy permits only package registries, GitHub and Anthropic endpoints. No tender detail page, portal listing or specification document could be opened, so ALL findings are captured at HEADLINE level only - deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, values and contacts are left null/empty and every tender is counted in entries_pending_detail. Tier 1 was covered across all nine jurisdictions: genuinely current November-December 2026 opportunities were surfaced for Commonwealth (AusTender/DFAT, CSIRO, Airservices, Defence), NSW (buy.nsw - FAFT panel, CCTV, Guyra Dam, rostering, Transport for NSW electric-bus advisor, HealthShare NSW, icare, TAFE NSW), Victoria (Buying for Victoria - Box Hill Institute, HealthShare Victoria, State Library Victoria, Gippsland Water, DoT Roads, Victoria Police, CFA, DEECA, Melbourne Water, South West TAFE), Queensland (QTenders - Queensland Rail panels, TMR reseal programs, Energy Queensland via VendorPanel, Brisbane City Council, Queensland Health, JCU), WA (Tenders WA - Water Corporation, East Metropolitan Health, WA Police, DFES, South Metropolitan TAFE; WAPHA own page), SA (DIT items via TenderHub aggregator only - the official Tenders SA portal did not appear in results), NT (QTOL - Land Development Corporation, Dept Logistics and Infrastructure roads/traffic), ACT (Tenders ACT - Canberra Light Rail advisors panel, interpreting services, Healthy Waterways research). Tasmania surfaced no confirmable November-2026 opportunity this run. Tier 2 captured GBE (water corporations, Queensland Rail, Energy Queensland, Land Development Corp), university/TAFE and health-service opportunities. Tier 3 (private sector) was queried (SAP Business Network Discovery / SAP Ariba, EstimateOne subcontractor packages, major-buyer portals) but no publicly-visible corporate RFx was found - those channels are registration- or invitation-gated, so no corporate tender was invented. Ten genuinely new buyer-originated sources were identified this run.
gaps: Direct page/document fetch is blocked in this session (WebFetch: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for all non-allowlisted hosts; re-confirmed this run against https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm). No tender detail page, portal search page or specification document could be opened - so EVERY tender is headline-level only and all are counted in entries_pending_detail. A future run needs egress to *.gov.au and buyer domains (or authenticated portal sessions) to extract deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, values and contacts. This requires the session's network settings to allow tender-portal and buyer hosts.

AusTender, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL and Tenders ACT are JavaScript-rendered portals that could not be read directly; Tier 1 coverage relied on search-engine summaries rather than the live portals or their feeds/APIs.

South Australia: the official tenders.sa.gov.au portal did not appear in search results this run (queries kept returning South African 'SA' sources). The three SA DIT items are from the TenderHub aggregator only and still need confirmation on the official SA portal.

Tasmania: no open opportunity with a confirmed November 2026 closing date could be surfaced from search summaries this run (a Treasury vehicle-hire tender closes 30 Oct 2026, outside the window). Deferred to a future run.

Several items (QLD Queensland Rail / TMR / Energy Queensland, WA Police / DFES / South Metro TAFE, SA DIT, Brisbane City Council, Airservices, Defence) were first spotted via third-party aggregators or news used only as a discovery signal; they are recorded against the buyer's own portal, but closing dates/status still need verification on the official portal.

Several aggregator snapshots carried stale 'age' metadata (e.g. 'buy.nsw ~850 days ago', 'Airservices 536 days ago', DFAT pipeline '441 days ago') that conflicts with the stated 2026 closing dates; all such dates are flagged in each tender's notes as needing verification.

Defence Medium Range Ground-Based Air and Missile Defence (bids due 26 Nov 2026) was sourced from a defence-industry news article rather than the live AusTender notice; included with a caveat. A related naval VSHORAD item (aggregator-only) was NOT recorded to avoid propagating an unverified entry.

Tier 3 private sector: SAP Business Network Discovery, SAP Ariba supplier portals (Woolworths/Coles/BHP/Rio/Fortescue), EstimateOne and major-buyer Coupa/Ariba channels are registration- or invitation-gated; no publicly-visible corporate RFx was found. Invitation-only consultancy/panel RFPs are out of scope and were not fabricated. Capturing corporate opportunities requires authenticated supplier accounts.

Some buyers were inferred from locality/context where the summary did not name them (e.g. Lakemba Nights CCTV -> Canterbury-Bankstown; Guyra Dam -> Armidale Regional Council; Council Wide Rostering -> unnamed NSW council); these inferences are flagged in notes and need confirmation on buy.nsw.
